runs.findings: Inspected both galleries. Shortened names fit; modal limit labels still clipped due resource priority. Narrow checker excluded wallet balance. Corrected in subsequent commits.

Inspected all 26 actual framebuffers. Terminal status, tab indicator, rewards and footer fit at both scales. Installed Q Shop funded/zero balances differ visibly; compact Limit All/You summary, total and disabled low-funds confirmation fit within the real modal. UI visual fixtures are not transaction evidence.

Inspected every actual PNG. Rejected all three: uniform cleared sky color, no visible terrain. Gameplay-tick capture preceded world rendering. Moved capture to render END and added variance/duplicate rejection. Native block evidence remains separate and valid.

Viewed all 18 panel-cropped, 64-colour review copies per viewport that the job logs print from the captured framebuffers (the gallery zips could not be downloaded here: the artifact blob host is blocked). Text fits at 1920x1080 GUI 3 and 3440x1440 GUI 2; teal tab indicator, warning colours, disabled buy/accept states, NEED n MORE, SOLD OUT, visit-locked, outside-city, offline and unregistered states render correctly. At 1440p the panel crop shows installed Q Shop screens only partly (review-copy limit, not a defect). No new defects.

Viewed all 12 downscaled review copies printed in the job log (six city frames, two bridge frames, two deck frames and two ground-road frames, seed 579). Both bridges render as stone decks on piers over open water with connected parapets and lanterns; ground roads cut through forest with slab ramps. Known rough edges: stepped diagonal edges, trees overhanging parapets, a rooftop in the Ironhaven oblique foreground. Two earlier runs of this tour were rejected after viewing (unconnected parapet posts; a bridge frame captured before its meshes were built) and fixed. Review copies, not the full-resolution gallery.

Decoded and viewed all 15 downscaled review copies printed in the job log (a top-down and an oblique frame of each city; per road a bridge from the side, a deck view and a plain-road view), seed 5908. Bridges on piers with connected parapets and lanterns over open water, ground roads through forest, real buildings in all three cities, no floating building in the six city frames. Known rough edges: oblique city frames half sky, trees touching parapets, plain grey road. Review copies, not the full-resolution gallery.
